acceptanceCovered: FR-1: clicking the heart on a Kudos card (highlight or feed variant) toggles the liked state for that card — verified via kudos-card.test.tsx, kudos-board.test.tsx, and the end-to-end kudos-page-client.test.tsx like-toggle test

FR-2: displayed heart count is post.hearts plus 1 when liked by the current user, updated in the same render as the click — verified via kudos-card.test.tsx liked-state assertions and the end-to-end test

FR-3: liked state is session-only React state owned by KudosPageClient, lost on page refresh, mirroring the F007 posts precedent — verified by reading kudos-page-client.tsx (plain useState<Set<string>>, no localStorage). Flagged for human review: this is an accepted deviation from the literal original task brief ("giữ trạng thái persist qua reload"), see clarifications.md "Session 2026-07-07, continued".

FR-4: a post authored by the current user (sender.name === currentUser.name) cannot be liked — heart renders disabled — verified via kudos-card.test.tsx, kudos-board.test.tsx, all-kudos-feed.test.tsx, highlight-kudos-carousel.test.tsx disabled-heart cases
FR-5: the toggle is idempotent per click with no separate pending/loading state (no network call) — verified by reading the synchronous toggleLike implementation, no pending flag anywhere in the diff
FR-6: the liked heart reuses the existing #FFEA9E accent color, no new design token — verified by reading kudos-card.tsx's liked-state class
Backward compatible: KudosCard with no like props renders the original static span heart unchanged — verified via kudos-card.test.tsx and all-kudos-feed.test.tsx backward-compat cases
kudos-card.tsx stays under 200 lines — verified, 198 lines
